about.title: About
about.what: {site} plays PS1 games in your browser. Nothing to install: open the page, add a game, use the keyboard or a controller.
about.rule1: Only games that may legally be shared are hosted here: homebrew, freeware and demos with explicit permission. No commercial games and no BIOS files, ever.
about.rule2: Games you add yourself stay in your browser. They are never uploaded and we never see their names.
about.rule3: You can optionally add a BIOS file you own. It is stored in your browser like a game and never leaves it.
about.rule4: This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony. "PS1" is used only to describe compatibility.
about.licence1: This website is free software under the GNU GPL-3.0.
about.licence2: Emulation by EmulatorJS (GPL-3.0) running the libretro pcsx_rearmed core (GPL-2.0).
about.licence3: Fonts: Archivo Narrow, Inter and Chakra Petch under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

home.title: Library
home.empty: No games yet. Add a disc image below.
home.findCoverHint: Looks up box art on libretro-thumbnails. Sends this game's title to that service; nothing else leaves your browser.
home.autoCoversAsk: Find box art automatically for games you add? This sends each game's title to libretro-thumbnails; nothing else leaves your browser.

drop.title: Add your own game
drop.hint: Drop .chd, .pbp, .iso, .img, .bin + .cue, .m3u, .zip or .7z. We recommend .chd — it is the smallest.
drop.privacy: Nothing is uploaded. Files stay in this browser.

errors.missing-cue: A .bin needs its .cue sheet. Select both files together: {details}
errors.missing-bin: The .cue sheet refers to files that were not selected: {details}
errors.missing-m3u-disc: The .m3u playlist refers to discs that were not selected: {details}
errors.mixed: These files do not belong to one game: {details}. Add one game at a time.
errors.quota: This browser is out of storage space, so the game could not be saved. You can still play it right now.
errors.unavailable: Storage is unavailable in this browser (private mode?). Games cannot be kept between visits.
errors.notAnImage: That file is not an image.

warnings.largeFile: This is a large image. The emulator keeps the whole file in memory, so low-memory devices may struggle. Converting to .chd makes it much smaller.

player.title: Player
player.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or this browser does not have it stored.

controls.title: Controls
controls.remapHint: Remap keys in the emulator menu → Control Settings.
controls.gamepadHint: Gamepads work automatically; press any button on the controller.
controls.saveHint: Memory card: use the emulator menu → Export save to download a .srm file, and Import save to load one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.biosOptional: Optional. Games run without it; some run better with a real BIOS you own. It is stored in this browser only.
settings.storageUnknown: Storage usage is not available in this browser.
settings.persisted: This browser has granted persistent storage: your games will not be evicted automatically.
settings.notPersisted: Persistent storage not granted yet. The browser may clear games if space runs low.
settings.clearConfirm: Really delete all local games, saves and BIOS?

covers.notFound: No box art found for "{title}". You can add your own image with Cover.
covers.failed: Could not fetch the cover. Check your connection and try again.

cloud.openLead: Open your online library from any computer with its passphrase.
cloud.createLead: Your library is encrypted in this browser. Only someone with this passphrase can see or play it — not even this website.
cloud.weak: Too weak. Use at least 16 characters or 4 words — this is the only thing protecting your library.
cloud.forgetWarning: If you forget the passphrase, the library is gone for good. Nobody can reset it.
cloud.wroteItDown: I have written the passphrase down
cloud.recoveryHint: Keep this somewhere safe. It opens the library like the passphrase does.
cloud.recoveryFileIntro: Memcard recovery key — paste it into the passphrase box to open your library.
cloud.noLibrary: No library found for this passphrase.
cloud.badInvite: That invite code is not valid.
cloud.exists: A library with this passphrase already exists — open it instead.
cloud.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
cloud.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
cloud.cannotDecrypt: The library could not be decrypted with this passphrase.
cloud.quota: Not enough online space for this game. The free tier holds about 9 GB in total; converting to .chd makes games 2–3× smaller.
cloud.uploadFailed: The upload stopped. It will continue from where it left off the next time you open the library.
cloud.pickTitle: Choose a game from My games
cloud.pickEmpty: All your local games are already online.
cloud.pickHint: Add new games to My games first; they are encrypted in this browser before upload.
cloud.empty: No games online yet. Upload one from My games.
cloud.closedHint: Open your online library on the home page with its passphrase, then start the game again.
cloud.corrupt: This game's online copy is damaged or was tampered with, so it was not started.
cloud.missingObject: Part of this game is missing from the online library.

share.libraryNote: Anyone with this code can see and play every game in this library, including ones you add later, until you revoke it.
share.badFormat: That doesn't look like a code. It has 16 letters and digits after MC-.

share.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
share.revokedLibrary: This shared library's code is no longer valid. Games you already downloaded stay in My games.
share.emptyLibrary: No games in this library yet.
